title: This Crater Burned for 50+ Years. Now the Fire Is Dying

scenes.text: A hole in the desert has been on fire for over fifty years.
In 1971, Soviet engineers drilling for gas hit a cavern, and the ground collapsed into a crater.
They lit it on purpose, to burn off poisonous gas. They expected it to last a few weeks.
Instead, it burned for decades. The crater is about two hundred feet wide.
Now, nearby wells are pulling the gas away, and the flames are finally fading.
A few weeks became fifty-four years.

description:
The Darvaza gas crater in Turkmenistan has burned since 1971, and now it is finally dying out.
Soviet engineers lit it to burn off poisonous gas, expecting a few weeks. Wells drilled nearby are now diverting the gas.
Would you have wanted to see it burn?
first_comment: Bonus: Turkmenistan's own president ordered it put out in 2022. Do you think they should have let it burn forever?
